input: Investigate crowdfunding platforms for my documentary project

gold.taskTitle: Investigate Crowdfunding Platforms for Documentary Project
gold.taskDescription: Research and evaluate crowdfunding platforms suitable for funding a documentary film project.

questions.title: What is the documentary's subject or theme?
questions.description: Understanding the topic helps identify platforms whose audiences align with the documentary's content.

questions.title: How much money are you aiming to raise?
questions.description: The funding target determines which platforms are realistically suited and whether fixed or flexible funding models are appropriate.

questions.title: What stage of production is the documentary in?
questions.description: Knowing whether this is pre-production, mid-production, or post-production affects what campaign materials exist and what funders expect.

questions.title: Have you run a crowdfunding campaign before?
questions.description: Prior experience shapes how much guidance is needed on platform mechanics, audience building, and campaign management.

questions.title: What is your target deadline for launching the campaign?
questions.description: A timeline determines how urgently platforms need to be evaluated and how much preparation time is available.

questions.title: Do you have an existing audience or community to leverage?
questions.description: The size and nature of an existing following influences which platforms and campaign strategies are most likely to succeed.

questions.title: Are you open to equity or only reward-based crowdfunding?
questions.description: The preferred funding model narrows the field significantly, as platforms differ between reward-based, donation-based, and equity crowdfunding structures.
